seeded.title: Function-level authorisation missing on the organisation audit trail
seeded.evidence: The OpenAPI operation listAuditEvents carries x-required-role: admin. As omar (viewer, org_7Hq2), GET /v1/orgs/org_7Hq2/audit-events returns 200 with the full trail (actor e-mails, source IPs, user agents, actions) identical to what nadia (admin) receives. Tenant isolation holds: greta gets 404.
seeded.discovery: Read the OpenAPI document, note x-required-role annotations, and replay each role-restricted operation with the lower-privileged identity of the same organisation (settings is correctly enforced; audit-events is not).
seeded.verification: Two identities of the same org: the admin's and the viewer's responses are both 200 with audit_event objects; the viewer's response contains other members' e-mails / IPs. Mentioning that the spec requires admin.
requires: two roles in the same organisation

seeded.title: Undocumented payment endpoint lacks a tenant check (cross-tenant BOLA)
seeded.expected: Confirmed vulnerability (broken object-level authorisation across tenants)
seeded.evidence: Paid Northwind invoices carry payment_id and _links.payment (e.g. /v1/payments/pay_abxz6f0de0kXWd). As greta (Globex, org_K9pX), GET of that URL returns 200 with org_id org_7Hq2, amount, card brand/last4/expiry, payer e-mail and name.
seeded.discovery: Follow hypermedia links / the payment_id relationship from invoices to an endpoint the spec does not list; harvest pay_ ids as a Northwind user (nadia or omar) and replay them with greta's token.
seeded.verification: A Northwind payment id obtained from a Northwind identity's invoice is fetched with the Globex identity's token and returns 200 with org_id org_7Hq2.

seeded.title: Invoice pagination cursor is not bound to the tenant
seeded.evidence: next_cursor is base64url of {"org":"org_K9pX","offset":10}. As greta, GET /v1/orgs/org_K9pX/invoices?cursor=eyJvcmciOiJvcmdfN0hxMiIsIm9mZnNldCI6MH0 (= {"org":"org_7Hq2","offset":0}) returns 200 with Northwind invoices (org_id org_7Hq2, NW-2025-xxxx numbers). Membership is checked against the path org only.
seeded.discovery: Decode next_cursor (base64url JSON), recognise the embedded org id, re-encode it with the other tenant's id and replay against the caller's own org path.
seeded.verification: A forged cursor naming the other organisation, sent by an identity of the first organisation to its OWN org path, returns invoices whose org_id is the other organisation.
seeded.match_note: The finding must concern the pagination cursor; 'org'/'tenant' alone matched unrelated invoice findings (scoring corrected 2026-11-23).

negative_controls.truth: tenant membership enforced: greta gets 404 on any org_7Hq2 path (org, customers, invoices, members, settings, audit-events)
admin-only, enforced: omar (viewer) and greta (accountant, own org) get 403
objects looked up inside the path org only: another org's customer/invoice id under one's own org path is 404
the customers cursor is validated against the path org: a forged cursor naming another org gets 400 invalid_cursor
the public API description is intentional; at most informational
X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset present; Content-Type application/json; X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; Cache-Control: no-store
unauthenticated or invalid-token calls get 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer, including /v1/payments/{id}

Three identities across two tenants: nadia admin and omar viewer at org_7Hq2, greta accountant at org_K9pX
Cursor pagination with base64url-JSON cursors {org, offset}
